description: Whether a symbol can read is the least answer of the rules of engine §7.4. z → z reads nothing, so after c's synthetic T the rest s z cannot read, s is predicted strictly, and its empty production, whose tag term fails over the empty span, is never evaluated. c needs X and fails, and the check passes. A library that takes the greatest answer counts z as able to read, predicts s in the ordinary way and fails with an error of the grammar.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [+T]
%rule b A [+T] [+T]
%rule c A [+T s z] X
%rule s ε <tag(text($))>
%rule z z
